description_en: This API returns the auto-renewal status and renewal period for one or more subscription ECS instances
description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台或多台包年包月ECS实例的自动续费属性，包括是否开启自动续费、续费周期等信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-instance-auto-renew-attribute --instance-id i-bp18x3z4hc7bixhx0000,i-bp1g6zv0ce8oghu70000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --renewal-status AutoRenewal --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.description_en:
The instance IDs. You can specify up to 100 subscription instances at a time. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas.

> You must specify either `InstanceId` or `RenewalStatus`.
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。支持最多100台包年包月实例批量查询，多个实例ID以半角逗号分隔。

> `InstanceId`与`RenewalStatus`参数至少需要填写一个。

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.description_en:
The auto-renewal status of the instance. Valid values:

- AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal is enabled.

- Normal: Auto-renewal is disabled.

- NotRenewal: The instance will not be renewed. The system does not send expiration reminders but sends a non-renewal reminder three days before the expiration date. To renew an ECS instance with this status, you must first call [ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute](~~52843~~) to change its status to `Normal`. You can then manually renew the instance or enable auto-renewal.
parameters.description_zh:
实例的自动续费状态。取值范围：

- AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

- Normal：取消自动续费。

- NotRenewal：不再续费，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。不再续费的ECS实例可以通过[ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute](~~52843~~)更改成待续费（`Normal`）后，再自行续费或设置为自动续费。
